newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SOCCER-SANDOR PUHL TO REFEREE EUROPEAN CUP FINAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SANDOR PUHL TO REFEREE EUROPEAN CUP FINAL.

text.p: Sandor Puhl of Hungary will referee the European Cup Final between Juventus of Italy and Borussia Dortmund of Germany, UEFA said on Tuesday.

Puhl, who will be 43 two weeks before the final in Munich on May 28, also refereed the first leg of the 1993 UEFA Cup Final between Juventus and Borussia and was the referee for the 1994 World Cup final between Brazil and Italy in the United States.
Markus Merk of Germany will referee the European Cup Winners Cup final between Barcelona and Paris Saint Germain in Rotterdam on May 14.

The first leg of the UEFA Cup final between Schalke of Germany and Internazionale of Italy in Gelsenkirchen on May 7 will be refereed by Marc Batta of France. Jose Garcia-Aranda of Spain will officiate the second leg in Milan two weeks later.
